claims: Crypto ATMs (or BTMs) are physical kiosks.
Crypto ATMs are often located in convenience stores and supermarkets.
Crypto ATMs allow users to buy cryptocurrency using cash or debit cards.
Crypto ATMs sometimes allow users to sell cryptocurrency using cash or debit cards.
Crypto ATMs provide instant transactions.
Crypto ATM transactions have fees of 6%-20%+.
Crypto ATMs require a digital wallet app.
Crypto ATMs require a phone number.
Crypto ATMs often require a government-issued ID for compliance.
Bitcoin Depot provides locator services.
CoinFlip provides locator services.
Athena Bitcoin provides locator services.
ByteWallet is a digital wallet app.
CoinFlip is a digital wallet app.
Crypto ATM verification involves entering a phone number on the screen.
Crypto ATM verification involves verifying via text code.
Crypto ATMs often require scanning an ID for larger amounts.
Crypto ATM transactions involve selecting the crypto.
Crypto ATM transactions involve scanning the wallet’s QR code.
Crypto ATM transactions involve inserting cash.
Crypto ATM transactions are usually sent within a few minutes.
Crypto ATM fees are typically 6% to 20% of the transaction amount.
Crypto ATM transactions have potential network fees.
Crypto ATM transaction limits vary by operator and registration level.
Higher registered accounts allow for larger Crypto ATM transactions.
